Callout.Name: Pharmacy Raid
Callout.Message: Controlled drugs taken from a pharmacy overnight.
Callout.Advisory: Rear fire door forced, alarm not raised.

Script.Line: The fire door was open when I got here.
I was looking to see if anybody was hurt inside.
I have not taken anything. Check the pockets, go on.

Lines.Approach: They came in through the fire door at the back and nobody heard a thing.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
